text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Ines! Long time no see~
Looks like you brought your part-time shift load
back to what it was before~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, sorry! Are you
maybe in trouble because you're short-handed?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"No way, of course not! If anything, I'm glad!
I was seriously worried you might collapse~."

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"Just say the word if you ever need someone to cover your shift.
Like when you're in a pinch with practice and stuff?
Oh, and if you ever wanna pick up a shift, I can swap with ya too."

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything I can do to help you out,
just let me know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"'...I've already adjusted your March shifts.
Make sure to rest up once the Osaka Hai is over.'"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Ines's running is our hope, after all."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "...Both my coworkers and the manager kept trying to anticipate things and accommodate my schedule."
choice_data_list: That's how much everyone is dreaming through you.
That's how much everyone is dreaming through you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha. Sheesh,
talking about dreams and hopes like that
is just way too dramatic!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll be able to give back
at least as much support as I've received?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, keep your hopes up just like that.
Alright, I'm heading out!
